subject: general
question: How many medals did India win at the 2021 ASBC Asian Youth and Junior Boxing Championships?
solution:
The correct answer is __**39.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **2021 ASBC Asian Youth & Junior Boxing Championships** were held in **Dubai**.
 
• **India** won **39 medals** in the competition of which **14 are gold**.
 
• The competition was conducted at the **levels of Junior and Youth groups**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ASBC** stands for **Asian Boxing Confederation** that conducts Boxing championships at various levels.
 
• **2022 ASBC Asian Youth and Junior Boxing Championships** were held in **Amman, Jordan**.
